facts.fact: 记忆一：祖母葬礼上姐妹并排摇椅
facts.anchor: Atalanthya Moon and her sister reclined side-by-side in rickety rocking chairs.

facts.fact: Aeloria：Iris 是唯一给过她一点尊重与爱的女人
facts.anchor: Of course I came to pay my respects to the only woman who ever offered me a crumb of respect and love

facts.fact: Aeloria 是 Iris 离开图书馆的原因、Moon 家的脏秘密
facts.anchor: I am the reason she left the Library.

facts.fact: 父母想囚禁她保家族 legacy：你护过我但也利用了我
facts.anchor: “You protected me when our parents wanted to imprison me to keep the family’s legacy intact,” Aeloria replied.

facts.fact: Iris 上台时被召来复活 Archivists 的正是 Aeloria
facts.anchor: it was me who you called upon to resurrect the Archivists.

facts.fact: Aeloria 只忠于姐姐：Catalogue 及其遗产烧了也行
facts.anchor: As far as I’m concerned…the Catalogue, its Libraries, and its legacy can burn.

facts.fact: Iris 招揽演说：几代馆员被驯成爱上为奴的羊群
facts.anchor: They have turned entire generations of Librarians into a herd of sheep who will grow up to love their servitude and never dream of revolution.

facts.fact: Aeloria 回绝：我不会成为你圣战的下一个伤亡
facts.anchor: I will not become the next casualty in your crusade.

facts.fact: 裁决：Iris 不是殉道者，权欲反噬其身
活着的两个理由：你比母亲好、Adrien 跟来了
facts.anchor: the map on your skin tells me you are a better woman than your mother
“It means I will not kill you today,” Aeloria said.

facts.fact: Iris 被拒后毁圣所并把世界交给 Deacon Prior
facts.anchor: she destroyed the sanctuary I built here and handed this world over to Deacon Prior.
